<style>
  /* ── Page header ── */
  .pagehead {
    position: relative;
    padding-top: calc(var(--nav-h) + clamp(60px, 9vw, 120px));
    padding-bottom: clamp(50px, 7vw, 96px);
    background: radial-gradient(120% 130% at 60% 0%, var(--field-bg) 0%, var(--surface) 50%, var(--surface) 100%);
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .pagehead .wrap { position: relative; z-index: 2; }
  .pagehead h1 { color: var(--ink); margin: 22px 0 24px; max-width: 18ch; }
  .pagehead .lead { max-width: 52ch; }
  .ph-motif { position: absolute; right: -80px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 460px; height: 460px; z-index: 1; opacity: 0.55; pointer-events: none; }
  .ph-motif circle { fill: none; stroke: var(--line-gold); stroke-width: 0.8; }

  /* ── Project cards: AI projects in two columns, sites in a four-up preview grid (the tazabbas.com arrangement, in the AYiN roles) ── */
  .projects-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: clamp(16px, 2.4vw, 28px); }
  .sites-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: clamp(14px, 1.8vw, 22px); }
  .project-card, .site-card {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    position: relative; min-width: 0;
    border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px;
  }
  .project-card { padding: clamp(26px, 3vw, 40px); }
  .site-card { overflow: hidden; }
  .site-card:hover { border-color: var(--line-gold); }
  .site-card:has(.site-link:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

  .pc-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .pc-top .pc-meta { margin: 0; }
  .project-index { color: var(--accent-ink); font-weight: 600; }
  .project-index::after { content: "\00b7"; margin-inline: 0.7em; color: var(--ink-muted); }
  /* status badge: a static dot and text, no animation */
  .status-badge {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 999px;
    width: fit-content; flex-shrink: 0;
    font-family: var(--sans); font-weight: 600;
  }
  .status-badge::before { content: ""; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .badge-live {
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success-ink) 14%, transparent); color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success-ink) 75%, var(--ink));
    border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--success-ink) 30%, transparent);
  }
  .badge-beta {
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-fill) 14%, transparent); color: var(--accent-ink);
    border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-fill) 30%, transparent);
  }
  .badge-built {
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 7%, transparent); color: var(--ink-muted);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
  }

  .pc-meta { font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-muted); margin: 0 0 10px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .project-card h3, .site-card h3 { font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 2.6vw, 2.2rem); margin: 0 0 10px; color: var(--ink); }
  .site-card h3 { font-size: clamp(1.3rem, 1.8vw, 1.55rem); }
  .pc-tagline { color: var(--accent-ink); font-family: var(--serif); font-style: italic; font-size: 1.15rem; margin: 0 0 16px; }
  .pc-desc { color: var(--ink-muted); font-size: 0.98rem; line-height: 1.65; margin: 0; flex: 1; }
  .site-card .pc-desc { font-size: 0.92rem; line-height: 1.6; }

  .project-footer { margin-top: 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 18px; }
  .project-tags { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .ptag {
    font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink-muted); border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 4px 11px; border-radius: 999px;
  }
  .pc-link { margin: 0; }

  /* site previews: the screenshot sits above the text on the card surface, never behind it */
  .site-thumb { margin: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background-color: var(--field-bg); }
  .site-thumb picture { display: block; }
  .site-thumb img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }
  .site-body { padding: 20px 22px 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
  .site-body .pc-link { margin-top: 20px; }
  /* one link per site: its hit area stretches over the whole card, preview included */
  .site-link::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; }
  .vh { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: -1px; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: normal; border: 0; }

  @media (max-width: 1099px) {
    .sites-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  }
  @media (max-width: 820px) {
    .projects-grid:not(.sites-grid) { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 639px) {
    .sites-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }
</style>
